name: rsi_extreme_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, sharp 2-minute directional bursts that push RSI_24 below 20 or above 80 represent concentrated retail stop-loss and momentum-chasing flow overshooting session VWAP. The moment RSI crosses back across the extreme threshold, the directional flush is exhausting — resting institutional limit orders positioned better than VWAP absorb remaining flow and drive a 10-20 spot point reversion over the next 30-90 seconds. Index-level reversion is faster and more reliable than single-stock reversion because NIFTY/BANKNIFTY are continuously arbitraged by futures participants who immediately fade deviations from VWAP-derived fair value, making the recovery self-reinforcing.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI detects fast momentum exhaustion. Original used 7-period on 1-min (7 minutes of context). We compress to 24 bars (2 minutes) because our hold time is 30-90s — the trigger lookback should match the hold horizon. At 5s resolution a 2-minute RSI is responsive enough to reach extremes during a genuine 2-min flush without being noisy from individual-bar price jitter.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open, reset daily
indicators.purpose: Intraday VWAP from session open. No scaling — cumulative measure is bar-size agnostic. Serves as the fair-value anchor: when RSI is extreme AND price is significantly below/above VWAP, both momentum exhaustion and mean-reversion pressure align.

indicators.name: vwap_dist_bps
indicators.purpose: VWAP deviation in basis points. Original required 30bps on equities. For NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index, a default of 15bps (NIFTY ~24000 = ~36 spot pts) represents a meaningful intraday deviation where VWAP-benchmarked algos accumulate aggressively.

indicators.name: vol_sma_120
indicators.purpose: 10-minute rolling volume average for relative volume calculation. Original used 20-bar (20-min) SMA on 1-min bars. Compressed to 120 bars (10 min at 5s) because recent volume regime shifts faster at 5s resolution; a shorter window better reflects current session participation. Used as context filter, not trigger.

conditions: rsi_24[i] >= rsi_oversold_threshold (RSI crossing back above threshold — exhaustion confirmed)
vwap_dist_bps < -vwap_dist_threshold (price still below VWAP — mean-reversion pull present)
volume[i] / vol_sma_120 > vol_mult (above-average participation on the flush bar)
vix < 22 (VIX regime filter — extremes can persist in high-volatility environments)
buy_ce.confirmation: RSI crosses from below to above oversold threshold on current bar (Wilder smoothing)

conditions: rsi_24[i] <= rsi_overbought_threshold (RSI crossing back below threshold)
volume[i] / vol_sma_120 > vol_mult (above-average participation on the squeeze bar)
buy_pe.confirmation: RSI crosses from above to below overbought threshold on current bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 spot points of adverse move at delta 0.5. If NIFTY/BANKNIFTY moves 8+ spot points against the reversion within 30s of entry, the RSI exhaustion thesis has failed — likely a genuine momentum continuation rather than a flush. NIFTY 30s typical adverse move is 2-5 pts; 4 pts sits at the upper range of normal noise, cutting quickly if the thesis is wrong.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 spot points at delta 0.5. NIFTY mean-reversion from RSI extremes with VWAP deviation averages 15-25 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds. Targeting 14 spot points captures ~60% of the median move at 1:1.75 R:R.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 15:00 IST (no new entries after 15:00)

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — same as original; extreme VIX regimes sustain RSI extremes rather than reverting them
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:00 IST — skip first 10 minutes of chaotic price discovery; no new entries after 15:00
filters.volume_filter: rel_volume > 1.3 (relaxed from original 1.5 since index volume is smoother than single-stock)
filters.trend_filter: none — RSI extreme already encodes the directional regime
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — RSI mean reversion is a persistent behavioral edge, but extreme thresholds (RSI < 20) occur less frequently at index level than single-stock, keeping trade count low enough to avoid crowding

adaptation_notes: Original used RSI(7) on 1-min bars of top NIFTY50 stocks with extreme thresholds 15/85. Converted to RSI(24) on 5s NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index bars. Key changes: (1) Lookback compressed from 7 min to 2 min because our hold is 30-90s — the trigger must match the hold horizon. (2) Thresholds relaxed from 15/85 to 20/80 because index RSI is smoother than single-stock RSI, so 20/80 is equally extreme relative to typical index behavior. (3) Relative volume window compressed from 20-min to 10-min SMA. (4) Spread filter dropped — limit order execution eliminates bid-ask spread. (5) ATR-based stop replaced by fixed 4 option-point stop calibrated to NIFTY 30s move magnitude. (6) Exit target is now fixed in option points (7 pts) rather than RSI-50 crossover which is too slow for a 90s hold.
weaknesses: RSI < 20 on 2-min NIFTY bars is rare — strategy may have fewer than 4 signals per day in low-volatility sessions
VIX < 22 filter removes the highest-volatility sessions where reversion moves would be largest
Volume filter less discriminating on NIFTY index than on individual stocks
No trend context — can fight a sustained institutional directional order flow
